name: 92121 · San Diego, CA
findings: ZIP 92121 (San Diego) has 183 nonprofit organizations. 82 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 71 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92121 (San Diego) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
